findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled by default, weakening the cryptographic hygiene of the key used to protect audit trail data.

No policy attribute is defined for the KMS key, so it falls back to the default KMS key policy that grants full access (kms:*) to the entire AWS account via IAM, which can allow overly broad access to any principal with IAM permissions rather than restricting usage to specific roles needed for audit trail operations.
